item.title: Stream Sync Engage
item.description: Powered by Mach Five Tech Stream Sync Engage A no-code platform for sending targeted, real-time messages to your app users: notifications, surveys, product tours, voicemail, and slideshows. Install the snippet, design the message, schedule the send. open_in_new Visit SSE Website description Read the Docs campaign Product Announcement What is Stream Sync Engage? A live engagement engine built for modern apps that want to go beyond static push. Three ideas, one platform: stream events in real time, keep every device in sync, and engage users with formats that earn a response.
